card.name: Commas before an added aside
card.fires_on: Mostly a comma right after a noun in a list or an appositive, where a clause like "though" or "a known..." might follow. Also fires on a few punctuation or word-break points partway through a name or word.

modes.label: Comma in list or aside
modes.description: A comma after a noun that opens a list or an explanatory aside.
modes.example: A mound is a general term for an artificial heaped pile of earth<<,>> gravel, sand, rocks, or debris

modes.label: Comma after a name or term
modes.description: A comma after a person's name or a medical term, before an appositive description.
modes.example: Jack McMahon<<,>> the defense attorney for abortion doctor Kermit

modes.label: Odd break points
modes.description: Splits inside a word or a run-on joint where text is broken mid-name.
modes.example: Overdosage with oxybutynin chloride has been associated with<< ant>>icholinergic effects including central nervous system

card.writes: It promotes "though" and suppresses "although", so it shifts which concession word comes next.
card.plain: It fires on commas and breaks where a side remark or list item is about to continue the sentence.
